reviews.title: Customization is the key
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for 324 days consistently. I’ve tried a couple of different apps and this has been the only one that has stuck successfully, and I think that’s because you can really customize it to your needs. I recommend when starting to keep it low pressure on your self. Start out only recording a couple of different things and just writing a couple of words in the journal part of it. Then over time, once you start to get into the habit of doing it daily, start to add the things that you would really like to track over time. 

Now that I have been using this for almost a year, I’m amazed at my personal growth. While I can’t say this app is the only reason for that, it has made it so much easier to notice patterns and growth in my life. I noticed concerns and used this app to track information which I then used as evidence for my doctors which led to medical improvements. I also found that journaling with this is so much easier than writing in a physical book and I’ve really learned to open up with myself and be more honest. It’s also so rewarding to look back at all of the data and see how just little small things have built up over time bringing me to where I am today. 

I’d like to conclude by saying I use the free version and I don’t think I’m missing out on anything. While the upgrades are pretty good, and could be beneficial for some (and I have considered upgrading a couple of times), I feel like the free version is exactly what I need at the moment and was exactly what I was looking for in a journaling/tracking app. I love the simplicity of this, it doesn’t put any pressure on you about anything which I think is why I feel so inclined to do it every day. You can also really customize every part of this to really make it work with your preferences and lifestyle. It’s a great app and I would be devastated if the company would change to focus on profits over their users (like so many companies seem to do).

reviews.title: Honest review
reviews.text:
Ok in this review I will not sugarcoat things and will be completly honest. IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A REVIEW, THIS IS IT. 

ADS
Well i noticed that when looking at the negative reviews for this app, there was a lot of criticism about there being too many ads. For the ads, there is an ad every time you want to save your daily journal log. But for me, this isn't too big of a problem because when there comes a time there is an ad, i just put my phone face down and enjoy life for 30 seconds. 

SUBSCRIPTIONS
There was also negativity about the subscription. I don't have lots to say about this. The app does find ways to drop little hints that it would like you to buy the subscription. But I don't have the subscription and the app works just fine for me. 

CLOVERS AND THEMES
Clovers are just the in game currency you can use to get themes for your calender to make it look cute. There are 3 new themes released monthly. You can only watch 3 ads a day to get clovers if you want them. 

OVERALL
Overall, i like this app! The aesthetics are nice and it is useful.
